DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Fifteen Kilos on a Bed

STS-HS11-L3-6501000-HSSCIENG1112-STP-IMR-01 • HS Science Engineering Design 11-12 • Qualitative and Quantitative Criteria and Constraints
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
In a pitch competition a team gets a few minutes to convince judges to fund one design and nothing else. Farida, Omid, and Zarina took every number on that board from their own first week in this city, when each of them arrived with one bag and did homework on a flattened cardboard box. Fifty five centimeters is the size the airline let them carry. Fifteen kilos is what a stack of borrowed schoolbooks weighs.
The judges add one more requirement. The desk has to feel steady when you lean on it. Is that something you can measure with a number, or something you can only describe in words? Say which, and say why.
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Farida doing?
Look at the picture. Say what Farida is doing. Then answer this: why would she want the team looking at that spot?
2
What is Omid holding?
Look at the picture. Say what Omid is holding. Then answer this: why would he hold it up where the judges can see it?
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Say what the teacher is doing. Then answer this: why would the team need that answer before the pitch?
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Say what kind of place this is. Then answer this: which things in the room prove it?
5
Tell me about the board.
Look at the picture. Say what the board holds. Then answer this: why would a design team put that on the wall?
6
What is Zarina wearing?
Look at the picture. Say what Zarina is wearing. Then answer this: why is that a sensible thing to wear in this space?
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: NGSS HS-ETS1-1 — Analyze a major global challenge to specify qualitative and quantitative criteria and constraints for solutions. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
